title: Mechanical screen: near-match for quotations with edge ellipses
scope: Extend the no-model mechanical quotation screen so a quotation whose only ellipses are leading or trailing still gets the existing bounded near-match comparison, exposing changed numbers and negations as candidates. Add regression tests; run the Python test suite locally on a branch. No corpus rerun, no change to stored results or public flags, no push or deployment without the owner.
